title: Zero-knowledge proofs
summary: Learn how to verify that a registered citizen record meets civic conditions without exposing the full dossier and disclose only the minimum necessary information.
dramaticDescription: The Agency must prove that a registered citizen meets voting conditions without revealing identity. The system verifies eligibility, but never exposes the full dossier.
introScene: Your mission is to build a verification that confirms a voter registry record is eligible to vote without exposing the name or the full dossier. The system only needs to validate the required condition.
